title: update_progress
description: A stage of an agent update between `update_agent` and `update_result` (0.1.22+ servers list `update_progress` in `server_info.features`). Never carries `status` (a message with `status` is a heartbeat) and is never the first message of a connection. The server keeps the latest stage only while it has a pending update for the device (and, when `to_version` is given, only for that version); `rejected` ends the update with `detail` as the reason. Unknown stages are ignored.

stage.description: received, downloaded, verified, updater_started (service); waiting_installer (Windows Installer busy, 1618 retry) and installing (updater, forwarded by the service); rejected (with the reason in detail); ignored_busy (a second command arrived while an update was running).

detail.description: Short text; the server keeps at most 300 characters and removes control and format characters.
